title: Core data for the Zariski to etale site inclusion
statement: For every scheme X there exist an inclusion functor from X.Opens to X.Etale preserving the underlying scheme, covers, finite limits and terminal object, together with continuity and representable flatness.

proof.text: Lift X.restrictFunctor to X.Etale using the Mathlib instance that open immersions are etale. The lifted functor forgets definitionally to X.restrictFunctor; functor laws are inherited by MorphismProperty.Comma.lift.

An etale X-scheme T has open image in X by lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap). Sending T to this image and an X-morphism to the induced containment defines etaleImage: X.Etale -> X.Opens. For any open U, an inclusion image(T) <= U gives a unique X-morphism T -> U by IsOpenImmersion.lift; conversely such a morphism puts the image in U. The two maps are inverse: containment proofs are subsingletons and morphisms agree after composition with the monomorphism U -> X. Naturality follows by the same monomorphism cancellation. Thus etaleImage is left adjoint to the inclusion.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03WT (etale morphisms are open); the factorization through an open subscheme is the open-immersion universal property

proof.text: Use the right-adjoint limit-preservation instance from Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Limits to obtain PreservesFiniteLimits i. Apply IsTerminal.isTerminalObj to isTerminalTop to obtain terminality of i(top). Since X.Opens has finite limits, flat_of_preservesFiniteLimits i gives RepresentablyFlat i.

Present a covering sieve S on U as Sieve.ofArrows V f. By Sieve.functorPushforward_ofArrows its image is generated by the maps i(f_j). The criterion ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff reduces covering to joint surjectivity. For x in U, the Zariski covering condition gives a member W -> U of S containing x. Its factorization through some f_j gives x in V_j. The point of V_j with underlying point x maps to x by Scheme.homOfLE_apply. This works for every covering sieve, including the empty covering of the empty open.

Apply Functor.isContinuous_iff_coverPreserving with the representable-flatness instance and the covering proof. Package the inclusion, its definitional forgetful equality, finite-limit preservation, terminality, continuity and flatness into the required existential conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00X6 and 00X5; finite-limit comparison supplied by the open-image adjunction, using Morphisms Tag 03WT

lean.statement:
theorem zariski_to_etale_core (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale),
      (i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor) ∧
      CoverPreserving (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology i ∧
      PreservesFiniteLimits i ∧
      Nonempty (IsTerminal (i.obj ⊤)) ∧
      ∃ (_ : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology),
        ∃ (_ : RepresentablyFlat i), True
